title: QA_Platform_counter_offer_unreadable_bid_id_is_not_found
preconditions: Authenticated buyer. 'WrongUuid1=' is a well-formed string that ParamsAuth decodes to nil (item_uuid -> item_id = nil).
steps: 1. POST raise_additional_request exactly as the journey does, but with item_uuid 'WrongUuid1='.
2. Read the reply.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 4 'Request not found'. With item_id nil the before_action cannot take the bid branch (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:5548), falls back to TradeRequest.find_by(id: nil) and returns 4 (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:5551-5555, rendered at app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:5596-5597). Nothing is created. Contrast EDGE-AWD-053: an id that decodes to a number crashes instead.
rationale: Pins the nil-decoding branch of the counter-offer before_action; a regression here would either crash or let the action run with no bid.

title: QA_Platform_counter_offer_price_sheet_as_object_must_not_500
preconditions: The journey's own pricing round {{pricingTradeUuid}} is closed and holds the QA vendor's submitted bid {{bidUuid}}; {{tradeProductUuid}} is the line the vendor priced. The request is answered by the before_action transform_bid_products, which runs before any bid-state check, so the outcome does not depend on whether the award left the bid active or selected.
steps: 1. POST raise_additional_request with sheets.inline_components.data sent as an object keyed '0' instead of a list of rows.
expectedResult: Must be a clean 422 (code 2). Today get_line_item rows are iterated with data.each, an ActionController::Parameters yields [key, row] pairs, and item[:creator_quantity] on that pair raises TypeError (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:5616-5617) -> HTTP 500. Nothing is written (the crash is in the before_action).
rationale: DEFECT-IN-WAITING: the shape of the price sheet is never validated before it is indexed.

title: QA_Platform_counter_offer_row_without_creator_quantity_must_not_500
preconditions: The journey's own pricing round {{pricingTradeUuid}} is closed and holds the QA vendor's submitted bid {{bidUuid}}; {{tradeProductUuid}} is the line the vendor priced. The request is answered by the before_action transform_bid_products, which runs before any bid-state check, so the outcome does not depend on whether the award left the bid active or selected.
steps: 1. POST raise_additional_request with one row that has price and product but no creator_quantity block.
expectedResult: Must be a clean 422. Today get_bid_products_array reads item[:creator_quantity][:configuration][:suffix] for every row before anything else (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:5617) -> NoMethodError on nil -> HTTP 500. Distinct from EDGE-AWD-066 (missing product), which fails later in get_line_item_object.
rationale: The unit is taken from the buyer's quantity block of the row; a client that sends only the changed columns crashes the request.

title: QA_Platform_counter_offer_row_as_plain_text_must_not_500
preconditions: The journey's own pricing round {{pricingTradeUuid}} is closed and holds the QA vendor's submitted bid {{bidUuid}}; {{tradeProductUuid}} is the line the vendor priced. The request is answered by the before_action transform_bid_products, which runs before any bid-state check, so the outcome does not depend on whether the award left the bid active or selected.
steps: 1. POST raise_additional_request whose data list holds a plain string instead of a row object.
expectedResult: Must be a clean 422. Today "..."[:creator_quantity] raises TypeError (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:5617) -> HTTP 500.
rationale: Type confusion inside the price sheet; one bad element must not take down the request.

title: QA_Platform_counter_offer_with_company_uuid_must_not_500
preconditions: The journey's own pricing round {{pricingTradeUuid}} is closed and holds the QA vendor's submitted bid {{bidUuid}}; {{tradeProductUuid}} is the line the vendor priced. The request is answered by the before_action transform_bid_products, which runs before any bid-state check, so the outcome does not depend on whether the award left the bid active or selected. The body additionally carries company_uuid (any well-formed value; Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999).
steps: 1. POST the journey's counter-offer body plus "company_uuid": "Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==".
expectedResult: Must be a clean 422 or the company key must be ignored. Today ParamsAuth turns company_uuid into company_id, the transform then indexes the data LIST with that id as a string (data['999999999'], app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:5521-5526) -> TypeError -> HTTP 500. The same transform is shared with the close-bid flow, which sends data keyed by company.
rationale: A field the shared transform understands for one flow (data keyed by vendor) crashes the counter-offer flow, which sends a list.

title: QA_Platform_counter_offer_global_fields_as_text_must_not_500
preconditions: The journey's own pricing round {{pricingTradeUuid}} is closed and holds the QA vendor's submitted bid {{bidUuid}}; {{tradeProductUuid}} is the line the vendor priced. The request is answered by the before_action transform_bid_products, which runs before any bid-state check, so the outcome does not depend on whether the award left the bid active or selected.
steps: 1. POST the journey's counter-offer body with sheets.global_price_components.global_data = "QA_Platform_x".
expectedResult: Must be a clean 422. Today the transform calls global_data.key?(...) for every global widget and then global_data[:trade_credit_discount] (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:5567-5582) on a String -> NoMethodError/TypeError -> HTTP 500.
rationale: Global (header) fields are negotiable in a counter offer; their container is never type-checked.

title: QA_Platform_counter_offer_sheets_as_text_must_not_500
preconditions: The journey's own pricing round {{pricingTradeUuid}} is closed and holds the QA vendor's submitted bid {{bidUuid}}; {{tradeProductUuid}} is the line the vendor priced. The request is answered by the before_action transform_bid_products, which runs before any bid-state check, so the outcome does not depend on whether the award left the bid active or selected.
steps: 1. POST raise_additional_request with "sheets": "QA_Platform_x" (text instead of an object).
expectedResult: Must be a clean 422. Today params[:sheets][:inline_components] on a String raises TypeError (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:5524) -> HTTP 500.
rationale: The very first read of the request body is unguarded.

title: QA_Platform_bulk_counter_offer_unknown_event_is_not_found
preconditions: Authenticated buyer. Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== is a well-formed uuid for id 999999999 (no such round).
steps: 1. POST raise_bulk_counter_offer exactly as the dashboard sends it, with trade_request_uuid Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 4 'Request not found' from the before_action (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:5551-5555). No counter offer is raised. ('WrongUuid1=' takes the same branch.)
rationale: The bulk action itself has no nil guard (TradeRequest.find_by_id(nil).bids, app/controllers/api/additional_requests_controller.rb:39-40); the before_action is the only stop.

title: QA_Platform_bulk_counter_offer_with_unknown_bid_must_not_500
preconditions: {{tradeId}} is the sandbox pricing round (open, no bids). The body also names a bid (item_type + item_uuid) that does not exist.
steps: 1. POST raise_bulk_counter_offer for {{tradeId}} that also carries item_type counter_offer_for_bid and item_uuid Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==.
expectedResult: Must be 422 code 4. Today the shared transform prefers the bid branch whenever item_type is counter_offer_for_bid and an item id is present, and calls Bid.find_by_id(999999999).trade_request on nil (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:5548-5550) -> HTTP 500, even though a valid event was named.
rationale: Same unguarded dereference as EDGE-AWD-053, reachable from the bulk route too; the event id in the body is ignored.

title: QA_Platform_bulk_counter_offer_sheet_as_object_must_not_500
preconditions: {{tradeId}} is the sandbox pricing round (open, no bids).
steps: 1. POST raise_bulk_counter_offer for {{tradeId}} with sheets.inline_components.data sent as an object instead of a list.
expectedResult: Must be a clean 422. Today the transform iterates the object as [key, row] pairs and crashes (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:5616-5617) -> HTTP 500, before the action looks for bids.
rationale: Bulk counter offers share the unguarded sheet transform.

title: QA_Platform_bulk_counter_offer_with_no_bids_answers_success
preconditions: {{tradeId}} is the sandbox pricing round: published, bid window still open, NO bids. (If an earlier case in the run placed an active bid on the sandbox, that bid — a QA vendor's — would receive the counter offer.)
steps: 1. POST raise_bulk_counter_offer for {{tradeId}} with one priced row, exactly as the dashboard's Bulk Counter Offer sends it.
2. Read the reply; then read the round and confirm no vendor shows a pending counter offer.
expectedResult: Today HTTP 200 {success: true} with nothing raised: the action counters only bids in status active and silently skips when there are none (app/controllers/api/additional_requests_controller.rb:38-55). Expected product behaviour: a refusal saying there is no vendor to counter. Must never be 5xx.
rationale: A 'success' answer for a bulk counter offer that reached nobody misleads the buyer; the dashboard hides the action below two bids (eventHeader.jsx:795-803) but the API does not.

title: QA_Platform_resolve_counter_offer_with_empty_body_is_not_found
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; no request ids at all.
steps: 1. PATCH resolve_additional_request with {}.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 4 'Request not found': no ids -> where(id: []) is empty -> verify returns 4 (app/controllers/api/additional_requests_controller.rb:145-152), rendered at app/controllers/api/additional_requests_controller.rb:70.
rationale: Baseline for the resolve endpoint: an empty answer must be refused, never treated as 'nothing to do, success'.

title: QA_Platform_resolve_counter_offer_requests_as_object_must_not_500
preconditions: Authenticated buyer. The request list is sent as a single object (a common client mistake) with a ghost id.
steps: 1. PATCH resolve_additional_request with requests = {"uuid": "Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==", "resolution": "accepted"} (an object, not a list).
expectedResult: Must be 422 code 2. Today requests.pluck(:id) is called on an ActionController::Parameters, which has no pluck (app/controllers/api/additional_requests_controller.rb:63-64) -> NoMethodError -> HTTP 500 before any lookup.
rationale: DEFECT-IN-WAITING: the shape of the vendor's answer is never checked.

title: QA_Platform_resolve_counter_offer_requests_as_numbers_must_not_500
preconditions: Authenticated buyer. requests is a list of bare numbers instead of objects.
steps: 1. PATCH resolve_additional_request with requests = [999999999].
expectedResult: Must be 422. Today [999999999].pluck(:id) evaluates 999999999[:id] -> TypeError (app/controllers/api/additional_requests_controller.rb:64) -> HTTP 500. (Sending the same numbers under request_ids is the supported form and answers 4.)
rationale: Two accepted shapes (requests vs request_ids) and no validation of either.

title: QA_Platform_resolve_counter_offer_dashboard_shape_unknown_id_not_found
preconditions: Authenticated buyer. Body in exactly the dashboard's shape (requests: [{uuid, resolution}]) with a uuid that decodes to 999999999.
steps: 1. PATCH resolve_additional_request with item_type counter_offer_for_bid, requests [{uuid: Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==, resolution: accepted}].
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 4 'Request not found' — ParamsAuth turns each uuid into id, the lookup is status active + resolution requested (app/controllers/api/additional_requests_controller.rb:146) and finds nothing. Nothing changes.
rationale: Pins the real client shape (redux/pendingTasks/api.js:15-20) so a change in uuid decoding inside the list is caught.

title: QA_Platform_revoke_counter_offer_requests_as_text_must_not_500
preconditions: Authenticated buyer.
steps: 1. PATCH revoke_additional_requests with requests = "QA_Platform_x" (text).
expectedResult: Must be 422 code 2. Today requests.pluck(:id) on a String (app/controllers/api/additional_requests_controller.rb:95-96) -> NoMethodError -> HTTP 500. Complements EDGE-AWD-073 (requests missing).
rationale: DEFECT-IN-WAITING: revoke trusts the body shape completely.

title: QA_Platform_revoke_counter_offer_requests_as_numbers_must_not_500
preconditions: Authenticated buyer.
steps: 1. PATCH revoke_additional_requests with requests = [999999999].
expectedResult: Must be 422. Today 999999999[:id] inside pluck raises TypeError (app/controllers/api/additional_requests_controller.rb:96) -> HTTP 500.
rationale: Bare ids are a natural client mistake; the revoke action has no request_ids alternative to fall back on.

title: QA_Platform_revoke_counter_offer_dashboard_shape_unknown_id_not_found
preconditions: Authenticated buyer. Body in exactly the dashboard's shape (requests: [{uuid, status: revoke}], no item_type).
steps: 1. PATCH revoke_additional_requests with requests [{uuid: Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==, status: revoke}].
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 4 'Request not found' — the lookup is status active + resolution requested (app/controllers/api/additional_requests_controller.rb:181-185). Nothing is revoked.

title: QA_Platform_revoke_counter_offer_empty_list_is_not_found
preconditions: Authenticated buyer.
steps: 1. PATCH revoke_additional_requests with requests = [].
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 4 'Request not found' (app/controllers/api/additional_requests_controller.rb:181-185, rendered at app/controllers/api/additional_requests_controller.rb:103). Must not be a silent success.
rationale: An empty revoke must not answer success; the dashboard sends [] when a vendor's request ids are missing (actions.js:175-180).

title: QA_Platform_counter_offer_log_for_unknown_request_must_not_500
preconditions: Authenticated buyer. Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999: no counter offer has that id or parent id.
steps: 1. GET the counter-offer log (counter_offer_details) for Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==.
expectedResult: Must be 422 code 4. Today the relation is empty, additional_requests.first is nil and nil.get_grouping_key raises NoMethodError (app/controllers/api/v1/additional_requests_controller.rb:156-157) -> HTTP 500, before any authorisation.
rationale: DEFECT-IN-WAITING: the counter-offer log screen crashes for a stale or mistyped id; there is no not-found branch at all.

title: QA_Platform_counter_offer_log_for_unreadable_id_must_not_pick_a_random_request
preconditions: Authenticated buyer. 'WrongUuid1=' decodes to nil, so params[:id] is nil.
steps: 1. GET counter_offer_details for 'WrongUuid1='.
2. Read the reply and note which event (if any) it describes.
expectedResult: Must be 422 code 4. Today where(id: nil).or(where(parent_id: nil)) (app/controllers/api/v1/additional_requests_controller.rb:156) matches EVERY top-level active/revoked additional request in the database; .first picks the oldest one (any company, any kind), Bid.find(its grouping key) loads an arbitrary bid (app/controllers/api/v1/additional_requests_controller.rb:157) and only then authorize/is_allowed_to_view refuse it (455 or 101, app/controllers/api/v1/additional_requests_controller.rb:159-162) — or Bid.find raises not-found (404). Never 5xx; a 200 would mean another request's counter-offer sheet was returned.
rationale: A nil id turns 'this request' into 'any request'; the tenant check is the only thing between the buyer and someone else's negotiation.
notRunnable: it sends an id that decodes to nothing, and the counter-offer log then matches every top-level counter offer in the database (v1/additional_requests_controller.rb:156); today it crashes (HTTP 500, verified live 2026-10-03), but the moment the crash is fixed without the scope it would copy another company's counter offer into our logs. Check it by hand with two test companies you control.

title: QA_Platform_quote_details_shows_counter_offer_history_after_award
preconditions: The journey's closed pricing round {{pricingTradeUuid}} with the QA vendor's bid {{bidUuid}}; when the run ticked negotiation.counter_offer the journey raised a counter offer that nobody answered, and the award submit then revoked it.
steps: 1. GET the vendor's quote details for {{bidUuid}} on {{pricingTradeUuid}} as the buyer.
2. Look at participants[...].counter_offer_additional_requests.
expectedResult: HTTP 200. Read-back oracle: the bid's counter_offer_additional_requests lists the journey's counter offer with resolution 'revoke' (void is shown as revoke, app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:5595-5610) — the award submit auto-revokes pending counter offers (app/helpers/api/proposal_helper.rb:168-169, 252-268). Never 5xx.
rationale: Proves where the buyer can see that an unanswered counter offer was dropped at award time and the award used the original price.

title: QA_Platform_pending_tasks_list_never_contains_counter_offers
preconditions: Authenticated buyer (PROCOL DEMO).
steps: 1. GET the buyer's pending tasks (older approval workflows).
2. Check every task's approval_key_attribute.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with pending_tasks; only approval kinds (event creation, surrogate bid, bid selection) appear — counter offers are filtered out by change_type (app/controllers/api/v1/additional_requests_controller.rb:10-12). Never 5xx (requested_by / item are dereferenced without nil checks, app/controllers/api/v1/additional_requests_controller.rb:19, 32-33).
rationale: The pending-task list is where approvers act; a counter offer leaking into it would offer the buyer an approve button for the vendor's decision.

title: QA_Platform_ai_counter_offer_without_line_ids_must_not_500
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; {{tradeId}} is the sandbox pricing round. The crash below is reached only when PROCOL DEMO's workspace has the Smart Suggest (AI counter offer) feature in its AI feature list; otherwise the policy answers 455 first (app/policies/ask_ai_chat_policy.rb:26-28), which also passes.
steps: 1. POST ask_ai_chats/counter_offer for {{tradeId}} with vendor_uuid and trade_schedule_phase but no trade_product_uuids.
expectedResult: Must be 422 code 2 (or 455 when the feature is off). Today get_counter_offer_data runs, then trade_product_ids.map on nil (app/controllers/concerns/ask_ai_chats_controller_helper.rb:1672-1676) -> NoMethodError -> HTTP 500, before the AI service is called.
rationale: Smart Suggest's backend has no parameter validation at all.

title: QA_Platform_ai_counter_offer_with_empty_line_list_must_not_500
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; {{tradeId}} is the sandbox pricing round. The crash below is reached only when PROCOL DEMO's workspace has the Smart Suggest (AI counter offer) feature in its AI feature list; otherwise the policy answers 455 first (app/policies/ask_ai_chat_policy.rb:26-28), which also passes.
steps: 1. POST ask_ai_chats/counter_offer for {{tradeId}} with trade_product_uuids = [].
expectedResult: Must be 422 code 2. Today the metadata SQL is built as 'WHERE ip.id IN ()' (app/controllers/concerns/ask_ai_chats_controller_helper.rb:1676-1678, 1720-1744) -> PG syntax error -> StatementInvalid is re-raised (app/controllers/concerns/conditional_api_caching.rb:93-97) -> HTTP 500, before the AI call.
rationale: An empty selection (the drawer with every row filtered out) produces invalid SQL.

title: QA_Platform_ai_counter_offer_for_unknown_event_is_refused
preconditions: Authenticated buyer. Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to a round id that does not exist.
steps: 1. POST ask_ai_chats/counter_offer with trade_request_uuid Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== and trade_product_uuids [{{tradeProductUuid}}].
expectedResult: Non-2xx, not 5xx: TradeRequest.find raises RecordNotFound -> 404 (app/controllers/concerns/ask_ai_chats_controller_helper.rb:1691), or 455 (You are not authorized to perform this action) when the workspace lacks the Smart Suggest AI feature. The AI service is never called.
rationale: Pins that an unknown event is refused before any prices are sent to the AI service.
